security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, metadata URLs, fixed documentation links, or controlled memory paths. The material risks are optional Python connector commands and related third-party query disclosure, which are legitimate for SEO research but should require explicit consent and clear data handling notices.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands can send keywords and topics to third-party services.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit consent step before running connector commands, and warn users not to submit confidential launch, client, or campaign terms.

remediation.issue: External Python helper examples accept user-provided keyword text.
remediation.suggestion: Document that hosts should pass keyword arguments safely and avoid shell interpolation when substituting user input.

content.value_statement: SEO teams often lose time turning seed ideas into prioritized content plans. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through keyword discovery, intent tagging, scoring, GEO checks, and topic clustering.
actual_capabilities: Runs an eight-phase keyword research workflow from scope through delivery.
Classifies keywords by informational, navigational, commercial, and transactional intent.
Scores opportunities using volume, difficulty, intent value, and optional impact-confidence inputs.
Flags AI-answer-friendly GEO queries such as questions, definitions, comparisons, lists, and how-to topics.
Groups keywords into pillar pages and cluster content ideas with internal linking guidance.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable to avoid invented data.
limitations: It cannot supply real search volume or keyword difficulty without connected tools or user-provided data.
Competitor-relative coverage gaps are outside its main scope and should use content-gap-analysis.
Optional connector commands may contact third-party services and need user approval.
Forecasts and priority scores depend on the quality of seed terms and market context.

prompt_templates.title: Start From a Seed Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research keywords for [topic] in [market/language]. Use estimated metrics only where tool data is unavailable, and label every metric source.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Topic Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pillar and cluster keyword plan for [product/service]. Include intent, funnel stage, priority, and suggested content type for each group.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Search Console Terms
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these Search Console queries and metrics to find striking-distance opportunities. Prioritize positions 5 to 20 and explain each recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Run Advanced Opportunity Scoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Score this keyword list with volume, difficulty, CPC, funnel stage, trend direction, and current ranking position. Separate Quick Win, Growth, and GEO opportunities.

output_examples.input: Research keywords for a B2B project management tool in the United States.
output: Executive summary with target audience, market, and data-source labels.
Prioritized Quick Win, Growth, and GEO keyword groups with intent and difficulty notes.
Pillar and cluster recommendations for comparison, template, and workflow topics.

output_examples.input: Map these existing Search Console queries into a content refresh plan.
output: Striking-distance keyword shortlist for positions 5 to 20.
Refresh actions for pages that need stronger intent match, internal links, or updated examples.
Next-skill handoff for competitor analysis when market comparison is needed.

output_examples.input: Find GEO content opportunities for cybersecurity training software.
output: Question, definition, comparison, list, and how-to keyword groups.
Recommended answer formats for AI visibility and human search intent.
Content calendar priorities with measured, user-provided, or estimated metric labels.

best_practices: Provide audience, geography, language, business goal, and domain strength before scoring keywords.
Separate measured tool data from estimates so stakeholders can trust the priority list.
Review intent and SERP format before choosing a content type for each keyword.
anti_patterns: Do not treat model-estimated search volume as measured keyword data.
Do not target high-volume terms without checking intent, difficulty, and business value.
Do not run third-party connector commands with confidential keywords unless the user approves.

faq.question: Does this skill provide live search volume by itself?
faq.answer: No. It needs an SEO tool, Search Console export, or user-provided metrics for measured volume and difficulty.

faq.question: Can it work without external tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can build a structured plan from seed terms, but unavailable metrics must be marked estimated or N/A.

faq.question: What makes it useful for GEO planning?
faq.answer: It flags question, definition, comparison, list, and how-to queries that can support AI answer visibility.

faq.question: When should I use another skill?
faq.answer: Use content-gap-analysis for competitor-relative coverage gaps and competitor-analysis for broader market comparison.

faq.question: Does it save research outputs?
faq.answer: The skill asks the agent to write a research summary under the project memory path when the host supports that workflow.

faq.question: Are the connector commands required?
faq.answer: No. They are optional helpers for keyword ideas, SERP sampling, and topic demand proxies, and should run only with approval.
